summary: Produced a compiled TikZ reconstruction (version 3, best) of the figure: horizontal chord P-A-M-O-B with solid circle centred at O through A and B, chords P-E-C, C-O-H-D, E-M-D, tangent P-D, dashed P-H with right-angle mark at H, and all nine labels (P, A, M, O, B, E, C, D, H). Version 3 received an automatic Critic review: must_repair false, score 0.90 (checklist 1.0), topology check passed with no missing edges.
